text: With no options, `tally FILE...` reads each FILE (standard input when no FILE is given or FILE is `-`) and prints one line per distinct input line, `<count> <line>`, sorted by descending count and then by first appearance. The count is right-aligned to the width of the largest count. An empty input prints nothing and exits 0. Lines are compared byte for byte; a final line without a trailing newline is counted like any other line, and output lines always end with `\n`. CRLF input keeps the `\r` as part of the line text. Several FILE arguments are concatenated in order before counting.
